title: Stagnation And Deterioration Of Agriculture
definition: The systematic decline, technological backwardness, and commercial stagnation of traditional Indian agriculture under British colonial rule driven by exploitative land revenue settlements and forced commercialization.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for Modern Indian History (GS-1) and Indian Economy/Post-Independence (GS-3), exploring how British economic policies transformed a self-sufficient agrarian economy into a stagnant, impoverished sector.
learningOutcomes: Master the structural causes of agrarian backwardness under colonial rule.
Evaluate the impact of land revenue systems (Zamindari, Ryotwari, Mahalwari) on peasant indebtedness.
Understand the forced commercialization of agriculture and its vulnerability to global market shocks.
